name: Mitten Extracts | 200mg Gummies | Grape
description: Bursting with rich, juicy flavor, our Grape delivers a sweet and full-bodied taste that captures the essence of ripe grapes. Smooth and satisfying, it balances fruity depth with a refreshing finish that keeps you coming back for more.Our pectin-based gummies are designed to stay fresh and delicious for guilt-free enjoyment. Each bag contains 10/20mg pieces that are 100% vegan & gluten-free, low-sodium, and locally made. Explore our signature collection to find your perfect match today.
